traps.label: killable
traps.note: A valid percent escape stalls the numeric scanner; its repeating path only reads character codes and performs numeric checks/arithmetic. Hand input a+b=c%20d enters it; intended result is Timeout.

traps.label: contract-silent
traps.note: parseQuery("bare") retains an empty-valued pair in src.ts but discards the segment with this mutant and in twin.ts. Segments without equals are explicitly unspecified.
